tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic bans deceptive artificial intelligence use and surveillance, clarifying ethical boundaries. Confirmed by DataBreachToday: the company tightens rules on deception.
Chula Vista adopts a policy banning surveillance and predictive policing without council approval. Confirmed by San Diego Union-Tribune: the city requires human oversight and bi-annual reviews.
Trump demands federal agencies use superintelligence instead of artificial intelligence terminology. Confirmed per 凤凰网科技: non-compliers are called enemies of the White House, and SpaceX may rename its artificial intelligence division.
McDonald's artificial intelligence pricing tool faces an antitrust lawsuit. Confirmed by Kelley Drye & Warren LLP: the lawsuit highlights concerns over data sharing and price recommendations.
OpenAI launches an ultrafast version of GPT-6.1 Sol. Reported by 36氪: a security check is underway for user access safety.
Free every hour.
